title: Kissed Creamy Italian Broccoli Pasta
description: A romantic Italian dish featuring purple sprouting broccoli in a creamy sauce, made with yeast and Calabrian ingredients, and cut in the traditional katsuramuki style, suitable for a satvik diet.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the katsuramuki-cut broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yeast and heavy cream, then add the mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet, tossing to coat with the creamy sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese.
